On August 25, 2026, Madison Air Solutions Corp (the “Company”) entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with certain institutional investors and a Securities Purchase Agreement with Larry Gies, pursuant to which the Company agreed to sell to the Institutional Investors and Mr. Gies, in a private placement (the “Private Placement”), an aggregate of 90,108,130 shares (the “Shares”) of the Company’s Class A common stock, par value $0.0000001 per share (the “Class A Common Stock”), at an offering price of $24.97 per Share.

The gross proceeds of the Private Placement are expected to be approximately $2.25 billion, before deducting applicable fees and other expenses.

The Private Placement is expected to close on September 1, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions (the “Closing”).
